summary.text: Wendy Fink is a Republican member of the Pennsylvania House of Representatives from District 94, which she has represented since December 2022, and she is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
Her career experience includes work as a part-time teacher at a private Christian school.

paragraphs.text: Fink was born in Columbia, Pennsylvania, and earned a bachelor's degree from Millersville University in 1999.
In the 2023-2024 session Fink was assigned to the House Children & Youth Committee, where she served as secretary, and to the Insurance and State Government committees.
